command: set -e; echo OWNER_MACHINE; hostname; whoami; echo RETINA_CORTEX_PATHS; find "$HOME" -maxdepth 4 \( -iname '*retina*' -o -iname '*cortex*' -o -iname 'frank_eye.py' -o -iname '*percept*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -100; echo RETINA_CORTEX_PROCESSES; ps -eo pid,comm,args | grep -Ei '[d]igital.?retina|[f]rank_eye|[r]etina|[c]ortex|[p]erceptual' | cut -c 1-210 | head -35; echo RETINA_SERVICES; (systemctl --user list-units --type=service --state=running --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -Ei 'retina|cortex|frank|vision|perception|bridge' | head -35; echo SENSOR_INTERFACES; find "$HOME" -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -iname 'retina.py' -o -iname 'retina_pipeline.py' -o -iname 'frank_eye.py' -o -iname 'perception_fabric.py' \) 2>/dev/null | head -35; echo END
